cards.text: It's the same day Jesus rose, and the two who walked to Emmaus have hurried back to the Eleven, Jesus' closest disciples, and those with them (Luke 24:13, 33). They're telling everyone how they recognized Jesus when He broke the bread (Luke 24:35). And while they're still describing it, Jesus Himself stands right there among them and says, "Peace be with you."

cards.question: The second Jesus shows up, the whole room bursts into cheers.
The disciples are startled and frightened. They think they've seen a ___.

cards.text: Jesus asks them why they're troubled and why doubts are rising in their hearts. I'd have been right there with them, friend, hiding behind my own mustache like it was a curtain.
Then Jesus says, "Look at My hands and My feet. It is I Myself."

cards.question: While He's proving it's really Him, Jesus tells the disciples to touch Him and see.
Jesus tells the frightened disciples to touch Him and see. What reason does He give?

answers.text: A spirit has no flesh and bones
His touch will calm their fear

cards.text: He shows them His hands and feet. They STILL can't quite believe it, but now it's because of their joy and amazement.

cards.question: While the disciples are still taking it all in, Jesus asks them a question. What does He ask for?
Jesus asks the disciples for something to eat. What do they give Him?

cards.text: And He takes it and eats it right in front of them. Spirits don't snack, friend, and if they did, I'd have blamed them for every cookie that ever went missing from my jar.
Then Jesus reminds them of words He spoke while He was still with them. They're about what's written of Him in the Law of Moses, the Prophets, and the Psalms.

cards.question: Jesus says only part of what's written about Him in the Law of Moses, the Prophets, and the Psalms has to be fulfilled.
Next, Jesus opens something so the disciples can understand the Scriptures. What does He open?

cards.text: He tells them what's written: the Christ will suffer and rise from the dead on the third day. And there He is, friend, standing right in front of them.

cards.question: Jesus says something will be proclaimed in His name to all nations. What is it?

answers.text: A new law for every land

cards.question: That message about repentance and forgiveness goes out to all nations, beginning in ___.
Jesus tells the disciples that they are witnesses of these things.

cards.text: Then Jesus says, "And behold, I am sending the promise of My Father upon you."

cards.question: Jesus tells the disciples to remain in the city for now. How long are they supposed to stay?

answers.text: Until they're clothed with power from on high
Until they've told the elders all they have seen
Until they've gathered every believer from Galilee

cards.text: Then Jesus leads them out as far as Bethany. He lifts up His hands and blesses them.

cards.question: While Jesus is still blessing the disciples at Bethany, what happens?

answers.text: He is carried up into heaven
He sends them out two by two
He breaks bread with them again

cards.text: They worship Him and head back to Jerusalem with great joy. From frightened to GREAT JOY, friend, that's a bigger turnaround than me going from the back of a junk drawer to a whole planet of my own!

cards.question: Back in Jerusalem, the disciples are praising God continually in the ___.
